data.one_liner: Add drop shadow effects to any Flutter widget easily.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DropShadow widget that applies customizable drop shadow effects to any child widget in Flutter. Allows configuration of blur radius, border radius, offset, opacity, spread, and color.
use_when: You need to apply a drop shadow to arbitrary widgets without custom painting.
You want simple configuration for blur, offset, and opacity of shadows.
avoid_when: You are already using container decoration or boxes that natively support shadows and don't need a wrapper.
strengths: Customizable shadow parameters like blur, spread, and color
Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and Web
weaknesses: Wrapper widget approach can add extra depth to the widget tree
